content.short: Aori is a universal intent settlement protocol for cross-chain execution.
content.description: Aori is an intent settlement protocol: users state the outcome they want and solvers compete to deliver it, with Aori settling the result across chains. Both Plasma's and Stable's official documentation list it among cross-chain and bridge options. Intent-based settlement hands routing complexity to solvers rather than the user.
content.meta: Aori is a universal intent settlement protocol for cross-chain execution, supporting Plasma and Stable.
